fields: She wins dark early river skirmishes. Only fight her when your lanes can move to help; otherwise trade objectives on the opposite side.
He wants long, messy early fights and you don't. Keep clearing, skip ego duels, and beat him later through tempo and objectives.
Don't give her free early skirmishes or grubs; one cashed objective fight makes the map much harder to control.
Her W blocks your R dash completely, so don't let her cancel your engage in narrow jungle chokes. Play cross-map instead.
Don't flip river fights or objectives into his burst and snowball. When he shows somewhere, punish lanes and camps instead of racing him in the pit.
Beats you in early short-range all-ins. If your lanes can't help, avoid his invade route and trade camps.
Her forced engage turns messy fights her way. Kite her first commit, don't chase into fog, and buy armor earlier.
Don't give him long run-ups through open river. Ward entrances early and fight after his first charge is spent.
Don't tunnel him through taunt and his anti-auto armor. Farm the opposite side, keep tempo, and hit targets he can't protect.
He matches your clear and wins early stand-and-fight duels. Avoid straight early 1v1s unless you have numbers.
Wins the first long all-in if you stand still. Break his axe rhythm, kite his first run and don't take early river fights into him.
Respect his early invades and point-and-click setup. If he doesn't snowball early, your clear and neutrals outscale him.
Dodge her spear first, then force close range; tight terrain suits you far better than open river.
Don't face-check isolated brush. Ward entrances, fight near teammates, and don't give him the first leap.
Track her marks and don't fight on ranged terms; save damage or E timing for when her ult zone ends.
Never give him an early stand-still fight at five stacks. Kite his opener and make him choose between camps and lanes.
Whoever gets first space owns the tempo, but one clean E in tighter terrain flips the fight quickly.
The danger is his reset, not the first trade. Kill cleanly or leave before he can possess someone.
Track when her point-and-click ult can reach you or your carry; save W for her commit, not before.
Respect his first hard engage, then win the longer front-to-back fight once he runs out of tools.
Don't dump damage into his clone or stack for a double knock-up. Make him reveal the real body, then re-engage.
Real early pressure, but if he whiffs his early tempo it gets much easier. Keep your route clean and punish failed plays.
Avoid clumping and track her engage angle; if she has to dive first, your counter-hit and follow-up are easier.
If she gets room to kite, the fight goes bad fast. Force tight spaces, make every E count, and don't chase into open fog.
Track his flag-and-drag and Flash angles; don't burn dragon form into his first engage. After his opener, fights get simpler.
He wants you lined up for a free engage. Fight spread out, avoid blind entrances and keep moving after the first bandage.
Don't isolate yourself around dark camps; with vision and nearby allies this matchup gets much better.
Respect cocoon and her early burst. Counter-ganks and opposite-side trades beat blind early 1v1s.
Punish him before he transforms and track his wall exits. Once he has his form, armor and front-to-back fighting matter more than greedy chases.
Track his W and don't overchase into his rewind zone; if he uses his ult early, re-entering is much easier.
Don't waste form or E into her mist; wait it out, then stick to her when she has no room to kite.
Respect her worked ground and wall angles around river; if you break through her zone first she dies fast.
You win early tempo and she wins later in fog. Press camps and dragons early, then buy vision and stop walking into dark lanes.
Sweep flanks and respect his charge and ult angles; if he spends his first engage on the wrong target the fight improves for you.
Control vision near walls and be ready for his second engage, not just the first jump; he's much weaker when he can't surprise you.
His displacement is annoying but he's squishy if caught. Dodge his E and R, then run him down; don't let him disengage free.
Kite his first burst and keep hitting; his early game is strong but you scale better into objectives and long fights.
Don't give her free melee proc chains; once her first CC is down you outdamage her and take neutrals faster.
Refuse bad early pillar fights, then beat him with better target access and objective control.
Don't walk first into sapling zones; if you reach the space first you outdamage him and take neutrals faster.
Outclear and out-take him. Track his taunt and cross-map ult and punish every time he leaves his camps.
Don't waste form chasing him through his ult; hit the nearest target, win neutral tempo and cut him off the map.
Front-to-back fights favor you as long as you don't throw away form chasing past him.
Avoid his sweet spots and long bleed-out skirmishes; if his first Q cycle misses, your sustained hits win.
He folds if you touch him first. Only invade with lane priority; otherwise beat him by owning dragons and first setup.
Sweep vision and deny flank fog so he must walk in from normal angles; owning the objective first ruins his engage.
Deny him free value from your ult and punish his slower clear; your first item and neutral control are usually stronger.
When he shows early, take camps, dragon or catch his exits; don't let his wall roams dictate your tempo.
Don't waste time fighting boxes and clones; keep tempo and drag him into real objective fights.
Don't give him resets; if you survive his first touch and keep him in front of you, structured fights favor you.
Avoid fighting on river or wall terms; flatter ground shrinks her burst windows.
Armor and vision remove most of the threat. Hold W for his re-entry and don't let him farm side control freely.
Fragile and tempo-based; reach him through fog or objective setup and he can't handle the long fight.
Dies fast if you reach him cleanly; just don't start the fight already chunked or in narrow space.
Sidestep her Q, bait out her black shield early, then run through her; she can't win first contact.
Hit his camps and timers, not Daisy; if he sets up a shielded front line first, the fight drags too long.
Don't path blindly through plant chokepoints; if you hit first or flank with vision she folds quickly.

general: Jungle guide. Max Q (Q-E-W early) and default to a full clear: arrive at the 2:55 scuttle healthy and only contest it with lane help or priority, since empty pre-form Shyvana is a weak river fighter. Gank early only when a lane is overextended, lacks Flash or has hard CC to follow your E. Levels 1-5 are a warm-up; level 6 (around the second clear) brings the first real dragon-form fights, the first item (Kraken Slayer) makes her strong, and 2-3 items is her peak, roughly 14-28 minutes. Build Fury on camps before objectives so you arrive near 80-100, set up the first dragon around 4:30-5:00 only with bot/mid priority, and don't press R just because the bar is full. Late game she is volatile: engage only on guaranteed angles, guard your form timer and play around Baron and Elder.
